title: Oven Roasted French Chicken Skewers
description: Savory and crispy French dish featuring dulce de leche, perfect for a nostalgic dinner, made with whole30-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, dulce de leche, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Sprinkle the chopped fresh thyme over the chicken.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
